A skill is a file of instructions an AI assistant loads before a task. This
project has two parts. The first writes a few skill files for building and
evaluating pharmacometrics models, assembled from published guidance and from
internal guidance documents turned into checklists that can be published. The
second keeps a ranked list of the pharmacometrics skill files others have
published, compiled each month by an agent against criteria set here. Nothing
is built yet.

## Documents

- [Specification 1: making the skill files](specification1-make-skill-files.qmd).
  The goal, the first skill on model evaluation in nlmixr2 in two modes, the
  inputs, the yearly rebuild, and the questions still to settle.

- [Specification 2: the curated list](specification2-curated-list.qmd). The
  categories, the quantitative ranking criteria, and the monthly agent run
  that finds, scores and publishes public skill files.

- [Proposal](proposal.qmd). One page: why skill files could replace static
  guidance documents, and the rules for consensus, position pages, review and
  governance.

- [References](references.qmd). The reading queue for the first reference
  list, with a status marker on every entry.
